translated_title: Sheinbaum: No Need to Take the Bait on Every Trump Statement, He Has His Way of Communicating
original_title: Sheinbaum: no hay que engancharse con cada declaración de Trump, él tiene su manera de comunicar
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: Responding to Trump's G7 jab calling her a 'scared' woman, Sheinbaum points to her security cabinet — Harfuch, the Defense Secretary, the Navy — and declines a personal debate.
